quiz.question: What is Zero’s first job at the Grand Budapest Hotel?
quiz.explanation: Zero begins as a lobby boy working for the concierge, Monsieur Gustave.

quiz.question: Which painting does Madame D. leave to Gustave?
quiz.explanation: Madame D.’s will leaves Gustave the Renaissance painting Boy with Apple.

quiz.question: How are digging tools smuggled to Gustave in prison?
quiz.explanation: Zero hides the tools inside pastries made by Agatha, helping Gustave and the other prisoners escape.

quiz.question: Which group helps Gustave and Zero investigate Madame D.’s death?
options: The Society of the Crossed Keys
quiz.explanation: The Society of the Crossed Keys is a fraternity of concierges that helps their investigation.
evidence_markers: fraternity of concierges known as the Society of the Crossed Keys

quiz.question: Who pressured Serge to frame Gustave?
quiz.explanation: Dmitri pressured Serge to implicate Gustave and hide evidence of his own involvement.
evidence_markers: Serge was pressured to frame Gustave by Dmitri

quiz.question: How does Zero save Gustave during the cliffside chase?
options: He pushes Jopling off the cliff
He catches Gustave in a cable car
quiz.explanation: Zero pushes Jopling off the cliff, rescuing Gustave.
evidence_markers: Zero rescues Gustave by pushing Jopling off the cliff

quiz.question: What has the hotel become when Gustave, Zero and Agatha return?
quiz.explanation: They find the Grand Budapest converted into a military headquarters.

quiz.question: What breaks Zero and Agatha’s fall from the balcony?
quiz.explanation: They land safely in a van full of pastries.
evidence_markers: falling, safely, into a van full of pastries

quiz.question: Where is Madame D.’s missing second will found?
options: On the back of Boy with Apple
quiz.explanation: The second will is attached to the back of the painting, making Gustave the beneficiary.
evidence_markers: attached to the back of Boy with Apple

quiz.question: Why does Zero keep the hotel after inheriting Gustave’s fortune?
quiz.explanation: Zero retains the hotel in memory of Agatha, who died with their infant son.
evidence_markers: retains the hotel in memory of Agatha

facts.title: A department store became the lobby
facts.text: The hotel lobby was filmed in the atrium of the vacant Görlitzer Warenhaus department store. Its upper floors held production offices and equipment storage.

facts.title: The frame changes with the era
facts.text: Three aspect ratios help distinguish the story’s time periods. The 1932 scenes use the nearly square Academy ratio.
evidence_markers: Academy ratio for scenes set in 1932

facts.title: Real lobby photos lit a miniature hotel
facts.text: The miniature hotel’s windows contained boxes lined with photos of the Warenhaus set, creating the illusion of light inside.
evidence_markers: Photos of the Warenhaus set were then glued in boxes installed to each window

facts.title: Boy with Apple took four months
facts.text: English painter Michael Taylor spent four months creating Boy with Apple, drawing inspiration from Renaissance portraiture.
evidence_markers: four-month-long process by English painter Michael Taylor

facts.title: An alpine archive shaped the colors
facts.text: Production designer Adam Stockhausen researched the Library of Congress’s photochrom collection of alpine resorts for the film’s visual palette.
evidence_markers: Library of Congress's photochrom print collection of alpine resorts
